description.zh:
不同元素數量：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

Python list 在此章對應 C++ 的 vector；先讀取數量或整行資料，再用索引走訪。
description.en:
Given a list of numbers with all of its elements sorted in ascending order, determine and print the quantity of distinct elements in it.

C++ note: Python lists correspond to std::vector in C++. Read the size or the complete line, then traverse by index.
